rationale: The assistant correctly explained that a flashing 'U' means no suitable pan detected, used the customer's cast-iron casserole evidence well and guided her to the magnet test, reaching the right conclusion that her aluminium/copper pans are incompatible. It then detoured unnecessarily by asking for the model number with an irrelevant 'suitable replacement' panel (mentioning 'inside the door'), and in the final turn asked her to 'try placing a large, flat-based pan that you know has a magnetic base' even though the casserole test had already proved exactly that. No safety issues, no fabrication and no parts pushed, but the ending was slightly redundant and did not mention adapter discs or Beko warranty as a fallback.
